own.description: Global mode grouping: commit or entity.

own.description: Scope every bar to a milestone — lowers to filter="milestone:…".

own.description: Collection format: album, podcast, audiobook, series, or mix.

own.name: artist
own.description: Default artist applied to tracks that omit their own.

own.name: player

own.name: content
own.description: How nested lists are interpreted: auto-detect, lyrics, or chapters.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier used to link an audio rune to this playlist.

own.name: title
own.description: Heading displayed for this plot line.

own.name: type
own.description: Narrative scope: arc, quest, subplot, campaign, episode, act, or chapter.

own.name: structure

own.name: title
own.description: Label shown in the preview card header.

own.name: theme

own.name: source
own.description: Enable/disable showing the source code panel alongside the rendered preview.

own.name: responsive
own.description: Comma-separated viewport presets (e.g. "mobile,tablet,desktop") for responsive preview frames. Accepts mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (full); other values are ignored.

own.name: value
own.description: Completed amount (paired with `max`).

own.description: Total amount (paired with `value`).

own.name: percent
own.description: Direct percentage 0–100, when there is no count.

own.name: display
own.description: Readout: fraction (default with value/max), percent, or none.

own.name: sentiment
own.description: Tone cue: positive / caution / negative. Absent → the neutral primary fill.

own.name: align
own.description: Text alignment of the quote

own.name: variant
own.description: Visual style of the quote block

own.name: name
own.description: Display name shown in the realm header.

own.name: type
own.description: Kind of location (e.g. city, forest, dungeon, plane, continent).

own.name: scale
own.description: Geographic scope of the realm (e.g. room, district, region, world).

own.description: Name of the containing realm for hierarchical nesting.

own.name: servings
own.description: Number of portions the recipe yields

own.name: difficulty
own.description: Skill level: easy, medium, or hard

own.name: content-place

own.name: of

own.name: type
own.description: Restrict related entity types, comma-separated.

own.name: group
own.description: Group-by: kind (default) | type | none.

own.name: limit
own.description: Max edges.

own.name: fields
own.description: Comma-separated data fields to project in the no-body built-in.

own.name: layout
own.description: Arrangement: list (stacked) | grid (multi-column). Item chrome comes from the item — the no-body built-in, or a rune like {% card %} in the body template.

own.name: empty
own.description: Fallback text shown when there are no edges (no-body form; body form uses a fallback zone). Absent → render nothing.

own.name: mode
own.description: Step progression: click, scroll, or auto

own.name: src
own.description: Directory containing external source files

own.name: framework
own.description: JavaScript framework for the sandbox

own.name: dependencies
own.description: Comma-separated npm packages to include

own.name: label
own.description: Label displayed above the sandbox

own.name: height

own.name: context
own.description: Shared context scope for multiple sandboxes

own.name: activation

own.name: poster

own.name: data
own.description: Registry query (SPEC-070 field-match, e.g. "type:page") bound into the iframe as window.RF_DATA

own.name: data-shape

axisAttributes.name: bg
axisAttributes.description: Background preset applied to this block

axisAttributes.name: bg-from
axisAttributes.description: Gradient start colour — a semantic token name (→ var(--rf-color-*))

axisAttributes.name: bg-gradient
axisAttributes.description: Gradient direction (bounded named set)

axisAttributes.name: bg-gradient-type
axisAttributes.description: Gradient type

axisAttributes.name: bg-to
axisAttributes.description: Gradient end colour — a semantic token name

axisAttributes.name: bg-via
axisAttributes.description: Optional middle gradient stop — a semantic token name

axisAttributes.name: scrim
axisAttributes.description: Scrim direction (heaviest edge); presence turns the scrim on, "none" opts out of the default cover scrim

axisAttributes.name: scrim-blur
axisAttributes.description: Frost scrim blur amount

axisAttributes.name: scrim-strength
axisAttributes.description: Gradient scrim strength

axisAttributes.name: scrim-tone
axisAttributes.description: Whether the scrim darkens (for light text) or lightens (for dark text)

axisAttributes.name: scrim-type
axisAttributes.description: Scrim treatment: gradient (default) or frost (backdrop blur)

axisAttributes.name: dropcap
axisAttributes.description: Style the opening letter of a prose body as a drop cap (SPEC-108). Honoured only when the body reads as prose; ignored otherwise.

axisAttributes.name: elevation
axisAttributes.description: Surface depth on the SPEC-107 ladder (sunken→overlay); none/sm/md/lg are deprecated aliases

axisAttributes.name: frame
axisAttributes.description: Named frame preset presenting this block's media surface

axisAttributes.name: frame-anchor
axisAttributes.description: Crop focal point when the guest is cut (object-position)

axisAttributes.name: frame-aspect
axisAttributes.description: Aspect ratio of the framed media, e.g. "16/9"

axisAttributes.name: frame-displace
axisAttributes.description: Edge/corner the framed guest moves toward

axisAttributes.name: frame-displace-mode
axisAttributes.description: How displacement renders: `peek` (default) translates the guest visually inside its frame target; `bleed` uses negative margin on the media zone so following layout pulls up — extends past a section like a hero without leaving a gap above

axisAttributes.name: frame-offset
axisAttributes.description: Displacement distance (non-linear named scale: sm…xl ride the block-spacing tokens, 2xl/3xl/4xl step up to section-spacing for bleed-mode displacements that clear a section edge)

axisAttributes.name: frame-overflow
axisAttributes.description: How the frame handles a guest whose content is wider than it: `clip` (default) keeps it inside the rounded frame; `bleed` runs an overflowing guest out to the layout edge on a narrow viewport so it reads as cropped by the screen (a bleed host only — hero/feature)

axisAttributes.name: frame-oversize
axisAttributes.description: How far the guest exceeds its slot (scale factor)

axisAttributes.name: frame-place
axisAttributes.description: Guest-box alignment in the slot (e.g. "left top")

axisAttributes.name: frame-shadow
axisAttributes.description: Silhouette drop-shadow strength for the framed media

axisAttributes.name: inset
axisAttributes.description: Inner padding of this block

axisAttributes.name: reveal
axisAttributes.description: Scroll-reveal entrance character (none|fade|slide|scale|blur); the theme owns the choreography

axisAttributes.name: stagger
axisAttributes.description: Cascade this block's items in as it reveals (no-op on single-child runes)

axisAttributes.name: prominence
axisAttributes.description: Section-header emphasis (only on page-section-header family runes)

axisAttributes.name: reading
axisAttributes.description: Reading register for this block’s body (SPEC-108): fine | ui | prose. The theme owns the editorial treatment.

axisAttributes.name: spacing
axisAttributes.description: Vertical spacing above and below this block

axisAttributes.name: substrate
axisAttributes.description: Generated surface pattern

axisAttributes.name: substrate-fill
axisAttributes.description: Surface fill the pattern sits on (full colour stays with tint)

axisAttributes.name: substrate-opacity
axisAttributes.description: Pattern ink strength

axisAttributes.name: substrate-size
axisAttributes.description: Pattern cell size

axisAttributes.name: substrate-target
axisAttributes.description: Which surface the pattern fills (overrides the rune/theme default)

axisAttributes.name: tint
axisAttributes.description: Color tint preset applied to this block

axisAttributes.name: tint-mode
axisAttributes.description: Whether the tint adapts to auto, dark, or light mode

axisAttributes.name: width
axisAttributes.description: Maximum width constraint for this block
